what: Charles River Laboratories supports drug discovery. It supplies research animal models, runs safety testing for new medicines before human trials, and manufactures and tests biologics for drug companies.
customers: Pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, contract manufacturers and academic research institutions.
money: preclinical safety testing and discovery services
research animal models and related services
biologics testing, cell therapy and microbial testing
moat: Safety testing capacity and regulatory track record that drug companies rely on to get trials approved, where capacity is limited and switching supplier delays programmes.
risks: Biotech funding weakness cut demand for preclinical services sharply
It reported a small loss after restructuring charges
Revenue has been flat over three years
Animal research faces regulatory and ethical pressure, and the US has signalled a move away from it
opportunities: Analysts see modest upside, with the preclinical market showing early signs of stabilising
Manufacturing and biologics testing grow faster than the core research model business
Cost reduction and capacity closures are intended to restore margins
watch: Net book-to-bill in Discovery and Safety Assessment, and demand from biotech clients.
